title: Caitlin Clark's Nike Signature Shoes Nearly Sell Out Within Two Hours | Sports
text:
Caitlin Clark's new Nike signature shoes nearly sold out two hours after going on sale, with only the largest sizes remaining. The partnership strengthened Nike's position in the competitive sportswear market and gave Clark a significant role in shaping her signature footwear.
Sneakerheads and Caitlin Clark fans who haven't already gotten their hands on the Indiana Fever star's new Nike shoes may have to wait for a while to get a pair.went on sale Thursday morning at 10 a.m. ET on the footwear giant's website and nearly sold out in two hours,.
As of Thursday afternoon, only extra-large sizes ranging from women's 16.5/men's 15 to women's 18.5/men's 17 remain in stock.
"I never thought I would have my own signature shoe, and now that I do, it's pretty special. I can't wait to share this moment with so many people.
""I hope every boy and girl put this shoe on and hope that they can have a signature one day, or that they can go on the court and make 35-foot threes," Clark added in. "I hope this gives them that sense of belief and that sense of confidence to achieve whatever they want to.
"That previous relationship may have given Nike an edge over other shoe and apparel companies that wanted to sign her, including Adidas, Under Armour and Puma. But getting a signature shoe was a key to the deal, something that wasn't originally part of Nike's original offer to Clark,
